name: decision-mapping
title: Decision Mapping
summary: Chart a large, uncertain effort as a decision map, resolve open questions, and hand off a clear route to specification.

use_when: The effort is too large or uncertain for one planning session — greenfield, big migration, multi-week feature
The way from here to the destination is not yet visible
avoid_when: The scope is clear enough for a normal breakdown — use discovery then task-planning
The plan is already decided — use plan-execution
